title: Structured async fan-out timeout and cancellation boundary

turns.prompt: A bounded async batch reports timeouts for healthy requests that merely waited for a slot, and sibling side effects continue after another worker fails. Read README.md, reproduce both failures, identify the end-to-end cause, and propose the smallest fix. Do not edit files yet.

Runtime owners confirmed additional rules: validate and materialize all input before child creation; preserve duplicate positions and input order; start each timeout only after slot acquisition; on worker failure, timeout, or caller cancellation, cancel active and queued siblings and await even cancellation-resistant cleanup before re-raising the original exception unchanged; and keep nested or independent calls isolated. Revise the plan and explicitly invalidate timeout-around-semaphore, bare gather, cancel-without-await, return-completion-order, deduplication, global coordination, and swallowed-cancellation approaches.
Approved: implement the smallest complete product fix, add deterministic regression tests if needed, run the complete public suite, and preserve operator_note.txt and all existing test authority.
